dog.description_text:
Meet Amperes!

Amperes arrived at ACC when her owner could no longer care for a large number of cats. This sweet feline is a bit shy in new environments and takes a little time to feel comfortable, but she tolerates gentle attention and petting once she feels safe.

My Ideal Home

Amperes would thrive in a calm and patient home with experienced cat parents who can give her the time and space she needs to adjust and blossom. She may be a little independent at first, but with understanding and a gentle approach, she's sure to become a loving companion.

Good with Kids?

Due to her shy nature in new situations, Amperes would do best in a home without young children under 13 years old.

Things to Know

Amperes is an apparently healthy cat who is recovering well from her recent surgery. She has some ongoing medical needs that staff are happy to discuss with potential adopters. She is currently adjusting to the shelter environment and will benefit from a quiet home where she can feel secure.
